## Fixed

- **Four broken call sites against omp's real extension API.** All four were invisible to this
  package's own test suite, because the suite stubbed the same wrong shapes the code called —
  every fake encoded the bug rather than catching it.

  - **`--idea`, `--lang`, `--model` and `--fallback-model` did not work.** omp hands a registered
    command its arguments as the raw remainder *string* (`handler: (args: string, ctx)`), not a
    pre-split array. Treating it as one made `--idea` throw
    `(args ?? []).slice(...).join is not a function` on every invocation — grilling could never
    start at all — and made `--lang`/`--model`/`--fallback-model` silently read the single
    character `"-"` instead of the value you typed (string indexing instead of array indexing).
    Only `--all`/`--fast` worked, by accident, because `String.includes` matches substrings.

    Confirmed live against omp 18.0.7 before the fix:

    ```
    $ omp -p '/readyset --idea let users export data as CSV'
    Extension error (command:readyset): (args ?? []).slice(ideaFlagIdx + 1).join is not a function
    ```

    Arguments are now tokenized by an exported `parseReadysetArgs` (quote-aware; `--idea` takes
    every remaining token, joined back together).

  - **A failed model pin looked successful, so the fallback chain never ran.** `pi.setModel` is
    `(model) => Promise<boolean>`, and its real implementation returns `false` — without throwing
    — when there is no API key for the model. Only rejections were treated as failure, so Readyset
    could report `Pinned model "..."` for a session model that never changed, and the configured
    `readyset.model.fallbackChains` was never tried. A `false` return and an unresolved spec now
    both count as a failed pin and fall through to the chain.

  - **The review panel's `setWidget` call used the wrong shape.** The real signature is
    `setWidget(key: string, content, options?)`; the extension called `setWidget(lines)`, so the
    host received key = the lines array and content = `undefined`, and the summary panel never
    rendered.

  - **`sendUserMessage` was passed options that belong to a different API.**
    `{ deliverAs: "nextTurn", triggerTurn: true }` is `pi.sendMessage`'s shape —
    `SendUserMessageOptions.deliverAs` is `"steer" | "followUp" | "aside"`. The options were
    ignored and the call fell through to the host's plain prompt path, so the turn still started:
    the documented rationale was wrong, the outcome happened to be right. The call now omits
    options, which is exactly what starts a turn when the session is idle.

- **`Theme` was imported as a type from `@oh-my-pi/pi-tui`, which exports no such type.** Harmless
  at runtime (type-only, erased at strip-time), but a standing type error — nothing had ever
  typechecked this package.

## Changed

- **`npm run typecheck` added, wired into CI and `prepublishOnly`.** `src/` is now typechecked
  against `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent`'s real types (added as a devDependency) — the contract
  `src/extensions/` is written against, and the one area the existing suite could not reach. The
  default `npm test` suite still needs no install at all, which is why the two steps stay
  separate.
- **The test suite's fakes now use the real signatures**, and it grew tests pinning down the
  `args` contract, a `false` from `setModel`, and the `setWidget` key — so the same class of drift
  fails a test instead of passing 187 of them.

## Install / Update

```
npx readyset-flow install
npx readyset-flow update
```
or with `bunx` in place of `npx`.

The extension module is referenced in place, so updating the package is enough — no re-install
needed.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fresp/readyset-flow/compare/0.11.0...0.11.1
